name: preview-slide
title: The file preview: the slide between pictures, to large ones not read yet, to one seen already, and steps in quick succession
description: Design 6.16 and 5.5. The note holds a small picture and two large ones (6000 × 4000 and 4000 × 6000 JPEGs with grain, several megabytes each), so that the picture stepped to is read, decoded and drawn while it slides in. Nothing may jump back, flash or go empty on the way: the thumbnail slides in at the picture's size and the picture takes its place where it is, with no second movement. A step back to the picture just left, which is still held and decoded, draws it sharp at once, with no thumbnail first. Then steps one after another, faster than a slide lasts: the file shown goes on from where it is drawn, never back to its place first. The desktop pastes the pictures; on Android the newest note must already hold the three, in this order (docs/ui/motion-check.md, Several files on one note on the emulator, and Large pictures).

movements.name: to-large
movements.description: From the small picture to a large one not read yet: → on the desktop, a fling on Android.

movements.name: large-to-large
movements.description: From one large picture to the other: ‹ › on the desktop; a slow drag past the middle on Android, held still before it is let go.

movements.name: quick-steps
movements.description: Three steps, each before the last has landed: → three times 110 ms apart; on Android three flings.

movements.name: back-and-forth
movements.description: A step, and back before it has landed: → then ← 150 ms later; on Android a fling one way and then the other.

movements.name: seen-again
movements.description: Once the file shown has rested, a step to the next, and after a rest a step back to the one just left: → then ← on the desktop, a fling each way on Android. The next is read ahead as the one shown rests, and the one left is kept, both held and decoded (6.16), so each slides in sharp, with no thumbnail first.
